title: 100% GDPR Compliance & 78% Fewer Crashes for a Legal Tech Platform

readiness

title: 20% Reduced Turnover for a Growing E-commerce Brand & Zero Payroll Errors
excerpt: A mid-sized e-commerce brand with over 25 remote employees was plagued by payroll delays, multi-state tax filing nightmares, and inefficient expense management. They needed a comprehensive solution to streamline payroll processing, ensure tax compliance, and boost team morale.
content:
Streamlined Payroll & Tax Filing That Boosted Compliance and Staff Satisfaction
Client
Mid-sized e-commerce brand with 25+ remote staff across multiple states.
Challenges
Delayed, error-prone payroll causing staff dissatisfaction
Complex multi-state tax filing requirements
No formal expense reporting or payroll compliance process
Gusto payroll system not fully integrated with accounting tools
Solution Provided
Set up and managed Gusto payroll for accurate calculations and tax withholding across states
Developed a clear expense reporting system with approval workflows for reimbursements
Filed monthly, quarterly, and annual payroll tax reports on time in coordination with the client’s CPA
Uploaded and maintained staff tax documents, W-9s, and pay summaries in a secure shared drive
Integrated Gusto with Xero to sync payroll data with the general ledger
Results
Reduced payroll errors to zero and achieved 100% on-time payments
Submitted IRS and state filings on time for three consecutive quarters
Processed team expense reimbursements twice as fast
Avoided penalties from late filings and ensured full compliance
Improved staff satisfaction, contributing to a 20% reduction in turnover
By overhauling payroll processes and ensuring seamless tax compliance, we helped this e-commerce brand not only eliminate critical errors but also enhance employee satisfaction and loyalty—laying the foundation for sustainable growth.

title: $75,000 Donor Funding Secured with Strategic Budgeting for a Non-Profit
excerpt: A Canada-based non-profit focused on youth empowerment was struggling with financial disorganization, delayed audits, and lack of transparency for its donors and board. Without a budgeting framework or centralized records, the organization risked losing funding opportunities and stakeholder confidence.
content:
Financial Planning That Built Donor Trust & Streamlined Reporting
Client
Mid-sized non-profit organization focused on education and youth empowerment (Canada-based).
Challenges
Operating without a structured budgeting and forecasting framework
Donors and board members lacked transparent financial reports
No regular bank reconciliation, leading to account mismatches and delayed audits
Financial documents scattered across spreadsheets and folders
Solution Provided
Created an annual budgeting and financial planning model using historical data and upcoming program projections
Established monthly bank reconciliation routines and documented financial controls
Built custom dashboards and quarterly financial reports for board meetings and donor updates
Set up audit-ready folders, sorted by fiscal year with all contracts, grant records, and receipts
Implemented Sage accounting software and trained staff on proper data entry procedures
Results
Achieved clean audit results for the first time in 2 years
Financial reports helped secure $75,000 in new donor funding
Budget variance reports allowed for more strategic program spending
Reduced financial data errors by 90%
Stakeholders now receive detailed updates within 5 days of quarter-end
By introducing structure and visibility into financial operations, we helped this non-profit regain audit credibility and donor confidence—making their mission more sustainable and their reporting sharper than ever.

title: 90% Fewer Billing Errors & 96% On-Time Documentation for Civil Engineering Consultancy

content:

Drafted, proofread, and submitted technical reports on behalf of project managers

Results
Billing errors reduced by
90%
, and payments collected faster
On-time project documentation increased from
58% to 96%
Vendor response time improved, avoiding 2 major project delays
